title: Binary String With Substrings Representing 1 To N
summary: Determine if the binary representation of every integer from 1 to n is a substring within the given binary string s.
statement: Determine if the binary representation of every integer from 1 to n is a substring within the given binary string s.
constraints: s contains only zero and one and n is positive.
Return whether every binary representation from 1 through n occurs as a substring.
reference_solution:
def contains_all_binary_values(s, n):
 return all(bin(value)[2:] in s for value in range(n//2+1,n+1))
hints: If every value above n/2 occurs, smaller values occur as suffixes of those representations.
Check binary strings for values n//2+1 through n.
Use substring membership and stop at the first missing representation.
Each positive x<=n/2 is the suffix of either 2x or 2x+1, one of which is at most n.
editorial: Each positive x<=n/2 is the suffix of either 2x or 2x+1, one of which is at most n.
